headline: 8 registered; 3 have a live cadence producer, 4 are ORPHANED (a producer was intended and never wired), 1 have no producer BY DESIGN. The SOONEST any registration can satisfy the 60-observation capital floor is 305 sessions (~1.2 years) from its current state, and that is the best case with no data block. The 4 orphaned can never reach it at any date: R58_DISCLOSURE_INTENSITY_V1, R58_FCF_PURE_V1, R58_FUND_MOMENTUM_VETO_V1, R58_SHORT_VOLUME_PRESSURE_V1.
forfeiture_semantics: A registration with no cadence producer is NOT a forfeiture. R66 settled that a cadence boundary at which the owner never froze anything is AWAITING_NEW_GOVERNED_FREEZE - a fact about governance, not a loss. That contract is untouched here.
what_this_answers: Can anything this estate has registered forward EVER be funded, and on what date. The capital gate needs 60 matured observations; an observation needs a decision; a decision needs a cadence producer.
